claim_boundary: This phase-programmed actuation overlay is a low-authority analytical falsification screen. It does not demonstrate a realizable time-dependent magnetic field, nested flux surfaces, MHD stability, magnetic-pumping absorption, alpha confinement, ignition, sustained burn, net energy, buildable coils, or hardware.

concept_image_translation.statement: The image is translated into an area-preserving poloidal m=3 shaping harmonic repeated inside each of the four baseline field periods. A global three-toroidal-lobe machine is not substituted for the unchanged 4FP ABAB baseline.

mechanical_architecture.statement: The vessel, blanket and primary HTS confinement system remain rigid and unchanged. Only an optional auxiliary field overlay is screened.
